claim.claim-text: 1. A handheld fluid meter for use in an oil bar, the handheld meter comprising:
2. The handheld fluid meter of claim 1, wherein the plurality of orientations include a standard orientation and an inverted orientation.
3. The handheld fluid meter of claim 2, wherein the standard orientation is distinguished from the inverted orientation by 180-degrees.

4. The handheld fluid meter of any of claims 2-3, wherein the visual output is oriented towards the handle in the standard orientation, and the visual output is oriented away from the handle in the inverted orientation.
5. The handheld fluid meter of claim 1, wherein the plurality of buttons are mechanically-activated buttons.
6. The handheld fluid meter of claim 1, wherein the control circuitry is configured to modify the functionality of the plurality of buttons based on the orientation of the visual output.
7. The handheld fluid meter of any preceding claim, wherein the display screen is oriented at an angle between 90-degrees and 180-degrees relative to the handle.
8. The handheld fluid meter of claim 7, wherein the display screen is oriented at an angle between 160-degrees and 170-degrees relative to the handle.
9. The handheld fluid meter of any one of claims 1-8, further comprising a nozzle, the nozzle comprising:

a nozzle stem disposed in the nozzle bore between the seating end and the fluid outlet, the nozzle stem including an overmolded tip, the overmolded tip including a tip cone configured to mate with and seal against the cone-shaped passage with the nozzle stem in a closed position.
10. The handheld fluid meter of any one of claims 1-8, further comprising:
a valve stem disposed in the valve cartridge, the valve stem comprising:

12. The dispense assembly of claim 11, further comprising:
13. The dispense assembly of any one of claims 1-12, wherein the plurality of orientations includes a standard orientation and an oil bar orientation.

14. The dispense assembly of claim 13, wherein the visual output is oriented towards the handle in the standard orientation, and the visual output is oriented away from the handle in the oil bar orientation.
